prompt:
An adult parent passes an envelope containing money to another adult parent holding a young child, at a neutral doorstep. The receiving parent accepts the support for the household. No labels, documents, coins floating, or court imagery. Each adult exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands.
Use attached reference ONLY for style: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, rounded simplified 2D forms, restrained cartoon shading. Single compact composition filling 80-90% of square, fully inside frame. 512x512 RGBA PNG, genuinely transparent background and gaps. No text, labels, border, logo, watermark.
en: An adult hands over alimony while the other holds a child.
ja: 子どもを抱く人へ、扶養のためのお金を渡している。
